name: app-pearl-mobile-app-in-hand-beside-stepped-bar-chart-board
title: Pearl banking app in hand beside a hanging truss poster with a stepped bar chart
whatItIs: A split image: at left a hand holds a pale pearl banking app with serif balance and quick-action avatars in hard sunlight; at right a poster hung in a steel truss with red eyebrow, headline about smarter banking and an ascending hatched bar chart.
whatItMeans: Precise and airy; the poster extends the UI's calm chart language into print.
techniques: Show app and print piece together in one grey palette.
Hang a poster in an industrial truss.
Draw hatched bars ascending like steps.
Use one red eyebrow as accent.

vocabulary.definition: A steel lattice structure holding a poster.
A bar filled with fine diagonal lines.
A small coloured label above a headline.
